     : forall (E F MN MF : Type -> Type) (FI : Measure.SemanticMeasure MF)
         (FC : @Measure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MF FI),
       @Measure.SemanticMeasureBindLaws MF FI ->
       forall (MX : Mixed.MixedMeasure MN MF) (FO : @Omega.SemanticOmega MF FI)
         (Ord : @Omega.SemanticMeasureOrderLaws MF FI FO),
       @Omega.SemanticOmegaLaws MF FI FO ->
       forall (Select : @Omega.SemanticOmegaSelection MF FI FO)
         (h1 h2 : Core.Handler.Handler MN E F),
       @HandlerRelation.peutt_handler E F MN MF FI FC MX FO h1 h2 ->
       forall (A B : Type) (RR : A -> B -> Prop) (c : @HandlerMachine.handler_config E F MN A)
         (d : @HandlerMachine.handler_config E F MN B),
       @HandlerRelation.handler_pair_rel E F MN MF FI FC MX FO A B RR c d ->
       @Measure.sem_lift MF FI
         (PrimitiveStableHitting.stable_target (@HandlerMachine.handler_config E F MN A)
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head F MN A))
         (PrimitiveStableHitting.stable_target (@HandlerMachine.handler_config E F MN B)
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head F MN B))
         (@RelationalHitting.stable_target_rel (@HandlerMachine.handler_config E F MN A)
            (@HandlerMachine.handler_config E F MN B) (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head F MN A)
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head F MN B)
            (@HandlerRelation.handler_pair_rel E F MN MF FI FC MX FO A B RR)
            (@PEutt.ptree_stable_head_rel F MN A B RR
               (@PEutt.bind_upto_closure F MN MF FI FC MX FO A B RR
                  (@RelationalPreservation.interp_rel_candidate E F MN MF FI FC MX FO A B RR h1 h2))))
         (@HandlerMachine.handler_machine_kernel MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select E F h1 A c)
         (@HandlerMachine.handler_machine_kernel MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select E F h2 B d)
